content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. 💪 Research shows you can build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (about 0 to 3 reps in reserve) and you do enough weekly volume. Heavier loads are more efficient, since they need fewer reps and less fatigue per set. And since your goal is a 100 kg bench, you'll need to train heavy at times anyway, because strength is specific to the loads you practice. A mix of heavy sets (3 to 6 reps) on your main lifts and moderate sets (8 to 15 reps) on accessories is a solid plan.
